```{r, results='asis'}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

projects <- c('P01'='P01 – Theoretical Task Force',
              'P02'='P02 – Grammatical Gender in Discourse and Grammar',
              'P03'='P03 – Mismatches in Binding and Coreference',
              'P05'='P05 – The Role of Self in Pronominal Coreference',
              'P06'='P06 - The (Non-)Deficiency and (Non-)Redundancy of Clitic Pronouns',
              'P07'='P07 — Deficiency and Redundancy in Iberoromance Pronominal Systems',
              'P08'='P08 – Fading Reference – The Pragmaticalization of Pronoun + Verb',
              'P09'='P09 – Animacy Features and the Flexibility of Pronouns',
              'P10'='P10 – Deficiency and Redundancy in Expressing Temporal Relations')

members <- read_excel('member_list.xlsx')

for (p in names(projects)) {
  cat(str_c('<a class="project-title" href="/subprojects/',p,'.qmd"><h2>',projects[p],'</h2></a>\n\n'))
  cat('<div class="accordion">')
  
  project_members <- members %>% filter(subproject==p)

  for (i in 1:nrow(project_members)) {
    member <- project_members[i,]
    cat('<input type="radio" name="select" class="accordion-select" id="')
    cat(member$short_name %>% str_replace(' ','_'))
    cat('"><div class="accordion-title"><span>')
    cat(member$name)
    cat('</span></div>')
    cat('<div class="accordion-content">')
    cat('<div class="accordion-box">')
    cat('<div class="accordion-leftcontent">')
    cat('<img class="accordion-picture" src="')
    cat(member$picture)
    cat('">')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('<div class="accordion-rightcontent">')
    cat('<div class="accordion-tags"><span class="accordion-position">')
    cat(member$position) 
    cat('</span>')
    cat('<span class="accordion-university">University of ')
    cat(member$university)
    cat('</span></div>')
    cat('<p class="accordion-links">') 
    cat('<a href="mailto:')
    cat(member$mail)
    cat('"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> <b> ')
    cat(member$mail %>% str_replace('@','[at]'))
    cat('</b></a>')
    cat('<a href="')
    cat(member$website)
    cat('"><i class="bi bi-link-45deg"></i> <b>  Institutional profile</b></a>')
    cat('</p>')
    cat('<div class="accordion-bio">')
    cat(member$bio %>% str_replace_all('\\n','<br>'))
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</div> ')
  }
  
  cat('</div> ')
  cat('\n\n')
}


```

<!-- Yanis da Cunha works as a researcher in Romance linguistics at the University of Graz. His PhD thesis (Université Paris Cité, France) deals with gender effects on function assignment (male-subject and female-object biases). More broadly, his research aims at discovering the factors underlying syntactic alternations (such as voice and word order alternations) across various languages (English, French, modern Greek, Spanish). -->
<!-- <br> -->
<!-- He is currently working on pronouns in French and Spanish within the subproject "Animacy features and the flexibility of pronouns". His contribution focuses on gender in the pronominal domain. He seeks to address the role of grammatical gender features in the animacy restrictions found on some pronouns (e.g., strong pronouns in French) and the way mismatches between grammatical and semantic gender features are accommodated by pronouns (e.g., a pronoun referring to a gender-underspecified noun). -->
